free_tier.stated: A 15-day free trial with no credit card, then a monthly credit that covers one project fee (EUR 9) and one user license (EUR 10) for as long as the account exists. Compute is not covered: shared CPU is EUR 0.033 per hour, guaranteed CPU EUR 0.100 per hour and memory EUR 0.013 per GB per hour, billed on provisioned resources.

retention.stated: 15 days is the free compute window; afterwards the standing credit covers only the platform fee and the seat, so a running app bills from the first provisioned CPU-hour at EUR 0.033.

egress.terms: Included egress transfer: 10 GB per project per month; additional egress transfer EUR 0.03 per GB.

interface_detail: Upsun Cloud CLI (the upsun command), documented at docs.upsun.com/administration/cli.html: manages projects, pushes code, opens SSH into environments and automates workflows; API tokens authenticate it for CI systems and cron jobs.
tooling: Upsun Cloud CLI (the upsun command; API tokens authenticate it for CI/CD and automation)
chaining: 15 days with no card is enough to measure whether a containerised app builds and runs on the platform, and the standing credit keeps the project record alive afterwards so the 15 days can be repeated later without a new account.
